final: SELECT ca.death_country, ca.country_avg, sa.simple_average, ca.country_avg - sa.simple_average as distance_from_average FROM (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) as country_avg FROM player_award_vote pav JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id WHERE pav.points_won IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country) ca CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(country_avg) as simple_average FROM (SELECT AVG(pav.points_won) as country_avg FROM player_award_vote pav JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id WHERE pav.points_won IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.death_country)) sa ORDER BY ca.country_avg DESC
